verdict.rationale: Formant's docs show a ROS 2 agent install path and a generic Agent/Cloud SDK for ingesting telemetry, plus multi-robot-type connectivity claims, which implies some level of standard-message ingestion (e.g., via ROS topics) but never explicitly names ready-made drivers or standard message types for cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS. Missing for 10: explicit driver/adapter documentation per sensor type (camera, lidar, IMU, GPS), confirmation of standard message-type support (e.g., sensor_msgs), and any hands-on evidence of plug-and-play sensor bring-up.
